prompt: A red-robed human shaman with soot-stained dark skin strides forward out of a roaring portal of orange flame, his side profile facing south-east, one arm thrust out. From his open hand a lance of fire lances across the frame and strikes a bandit, who recoils mid-stride, his leather jerkin already burning, mouth agape. The shaman wears scorched crimson and brass robes. The background is a dim medieval forest road at dusk, the only source of light the orange fire.

Low wide shot of a human shaman in tattered crimson robes crouched inside a glowing orange conjuring sigil etched on stone flagstones, both hands slammed to the ground. A torrent of living flame erupts outward from the circle and engulfs a fleeing soldier at the right edge of the frame, his back arched, armor glowing red-hot. The background is the dark interior of a ruined stone hall lit only by the erupting fire.

A human shaman in scorched red and ash-gray robes tears open a jagged rift of orange fire with both hands raised. A snarling elemental of living flame lunges out of the rift and sinks its claws into a screaming peasant, who is thrown backward, his tunic ablaze. The shaman stands in left profile facing the rift. The background is a smoke-filled village square at night, the only source of light the fire elemental.

Close-up of a terrified bearded man recoiling toward the viewer, his arm flung up to shield his face, his sleeve and beard catching fire, skin lit harsh orange. Behind him, looming in the smoke, the silhouette of a red-robed human shaman just summoned, one hand extended, fire streaming from his palm into the man. The background is a dark burning hut interior, the only source of light the flames on the man.

A human shaman in crimson and gold robes stands in a wide stance, side profile facing east, both hands sweeping forward as two roaring bolts of orange fire streak from his palms across the frame and slam into a charging knight, whose shield and surcoat burst into flame, knocking him backward. The shaman has dark soot-stained skin and a shaved head. The background is a windswept battlefield ridge at dusk, the only source of light the fire bolts.
